page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data storage needs. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. A key architectural characteristic is the 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring that each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core without hyperthreading, which eliminates resource contention between threads on the same core.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio position this instance for workloads requiring predictable compute performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, enterprise application hosting, web serving, and general-purpose backend services that demand consistent CPU execution and moderate memory capacity.
